what: P12.0 — the four families' ONE fixed parameter each, byte-pinned before the replay; changed only by a dated amendment, never after a number has been seen (S71)

costs.forward_spread: half the l2Book spread at the trigger poll, pinned verbatim

F1.name: funding extreme
F1.direction: against the sign of the print

F2.name: reversion after a large move with volume

F4.name: follow the leaders
F4.mechanism: information the leader has and the record does not

controls.C1: one uniformly random entry minute per coin per day, seeded by the day's amendment commit sha + coin + date; direction long with probability = that day's long share among F1-F4 signals (0.5 when none)

pass_line.k: ceil(log2 N) + 2 consecutive forward days beating BOTH controls on daily net
pass_line.and: mean net over the fork's forward episodes > 2 sigma / sqrt(n)
